messages.subject: Select a Client Folder
parts:
For a shiny app running on a server (not local), how may I interactively select the path of a client folder? Like fileInput(), only I want to return the path to a folder as a string rather than a file.

So for example the client computer and the server computer are both on the same network. There is a network drive that is accessible to both. I want an app where the client may select a folder on the network drive, interactively like fileInput(). Then the server receive the path, and do an operation on all the files in that network folder.

Jonathan
